messages.title: Theta Squadron arrival orders
messages.message:
FROM: 1SG S████████ V█████
SENT: 2575-08-08-2601:18
TO: ROXARA LUNAR MINING COMPLEX – OPERATIONS
SUBJECT: ███ THETA SQUADRON - ARRIVAL PROTOCOL

CONFIDENTIAL – DO NOT SHARE

ATTN. ROXARA LUNAR MINING COMPLEX,

Theta Squadron is en route, anticipate arrival to Roxara on
2575-08-09-███████. A ███████████████ Freighter will arrive in advance of Theta Squadron. Prepare docking accommodations accordingly.

Our work must begin immediately upon landing. Ensure the cargo manifest below is on board the ███████████████ Freighter. Failure to indicate inconsistencies will not be tolerated.

Take the utmost caution when handling the crates. They are pivotal to our research. Any carelessness or mistreatment could jeopardize the success of our operation.

For the Glory of the ████████.

S. V█████
12974-S
